basis: The chart title explicitly states 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4', which directly contradicts the visual data showing an overall increase from Q1 (≈1080) to Q4 (≈1620). Since the visual trend contradicts the title, the title's assertion of stability must be prioritized over the visual pattern. The 'Route to revenue stability response' is the only option explicitly justified by the authoritative title, even though the visual data does not support it.
